events.text: Quebec surrenders to the British during the Seven Years' War.
George Washington lays the cornerstone of the U.S. Capitol.
The U.S. Congress passes the Fugitive Slave Act.
The New York Times publishes its first issue.
The Columbia Phonographic Broadcasting System, later CBS, goes on the air.
The United States Air Force is established as a separate military branch.
Voyager 1 takes the first photograph of the Earth and Moon together.
ICANN is founded to manage the internet's domain name system.
Scotland votes against independence in a referendum.
